summary: Specified the local MCP autolaunch protocol contract for Codex-driven agent worker lifecycle: a 6-state finite state machine (IDLE->PICKUP->GUARD->LAUNCH->POLL->COMPLETE), per-model runner isolation with file-lock-mediated claim serialization, 4 mandatory safety gates with default-disabled env dual-gate, a 18-field structured audit log schema, stale detection with timeout-per-adapter + force-recovery path, usage accounting integrated with taskctl.py usage records, and a completion return path through taskctl review -> completion_inbox -> Codex finalize. Zero implementation code; all authority_flags are false.
builds_on: taskctl.py (auto-pickup, guard, start, review, done, usage)
mcp_neural_launch_routing_migration_b254_v1 (neural routing targets, abstain classes, adapter_of labels)

state_machine.title: Autolaunch Lifecycle Finite State Machine
state_machine.description: The autolaunch protocol defines a 6-state FSM governing each task's journey from queue to completion. States are tracked via taskctl.py lifecycle (pending/processing/review/finished) plus worker_status substate. All transitions are gated. Stale detection introduces a recovery transition from any non-terminal state back to IDLE.

IDLE.description: Task is pending in queue, unclaimed (worker_status=unclaimed, status=pending).
IDLE.entry_condition: task card exists with status=pending, worker_status=unclaimed

PICKUP.description: Autolaunch orchestrator selects task for runner/topic. Claim is atomic (file-lock serialized).
PICKUP.entry_condition: auto-pickup selects first unclaimed pending task matching runner/topic; batch_mismatch guard passes
PICKUP.exit_condition: task card worker_status=claimed, claimed_by set, claimed_at timestamped

GUARD.description: All 4 safety gates evaluated in order. Failure at any gate blocks launch.
GUARD.exit_condition: G1 AND G2 AND G3 AND G4 all return PASS

LAUNCH.description: Worker process spawned via per-adapter CLI template. MCP server returns immediately.
LAUNCH.entry_condition: all 4 gates PASS; adapter binary resolvable; env vars set
LAUNCH.exit_condition: worker process spawned; launch audit record written

POLL.description: Completion polling loop: check taskctl.py for review state or staleness.
POLL.entry_condition: worker process running (or deepseek_manual task in-progress)

COMPLETE.description: Worker finished. taskctl.py review called. Awaiting Codex finalization.

transitions.trigger: any gate failure or guard rejection

transitions.guard: G1 AND G2 AND G3 AND G4
NOT (G1 AND G2 AND G3 AND G4)

runner_isolation.title: Per-Model Runner Isolation Contract
invariants: One task -> exactly one owning runner/topic pair
One runner -> at most one in-progress task at a time
Claim atomicity via file-lock serialized read-choose-update
Runner batch token must match task batch token when both present
Runner cannot claim task outside its assigned topic
No cross-runner writes; each worker receives only its allowed_writes

collision_handling.detection: taskctl.py collision-guard scans active cards for overlapping allowed_writes
collision_handling.resolution: collision -> abstain (do not launch); neural router learns collision-abstain from b254 curriculum rows
collision_handling.same_task_guard: second claim on already-claimed task is rejected (worker_status != unclaimed check)

safety_gates.title: 4-Layer Mandatory Safety Gate Contract
safety_gates.description: Every autolaunch MUST pass all four gates in order before spawning a worker process. Gates evaluated sequentially; short-circuit on first failure.

gates.name: Environment Dual-Gate
gates.rationale: Owner must explicitly opt in to automated launches. Outermost safety ring.

gates.name: Taskctl Identity and State Guard
gates.rationale: Prevents misconfigured autolaunch from claiming wrong/stale/already-owned task.

gates.name: Allowed Writes Scope Enforcement
gates.contract: allowed_writes non-empty, all paths within repo, no forbidden path intersections, no active-task overlap
checks: no collision with other active tasks
gates.rationale: Defense against task card with accidental write access to runtime authority or other workers.

gates.name: Launch Implementation Feature Flag
gates.contract: LAUNCH_IMPLEMENTED constant must be True before real process spawn
gates.rationale: This is a DESIGN spec. No launch code exists. G4 blocks all launches until explicitly flipped by implementation task.

stale_recovery.title: Stale Detection and Recovery Protocol
stale_recovery.detection_method: completion_inbox polls taskctl.py runner-status; compares elapsed time against adapter.stale_timeout_seconds
stale_recovery.recovery_action: taskctl.py recover-stale <task_id> --force resets worker_status to unclaimed, returns task to IDLE
stale_recovery.audit_trail: stale_detected_at recorded in audit log; completion_inbox emits stale_warning

usage_accounting.title: Cost and Usage Accounting Integration
usage_accounting.worker_path: python3 AITools/taskctl.py usage <task_id> --runner <runner> --model <model> --input-tokens N --output-tokens N [--cost-usd X]
usage_accounting.reporting: taskctl.py usage-report aggregates by runner, model, provider, topic

completion_return_path.title: Completion to Codex Review Return Path

steps.action: Write outputs to allowed_writes; run tests
Detect review_queue entry; report to Codex

invariants: One commit per task; no unrelated dirty file sweep

invariants.no_execution_code: Zero process-launch code. All CLI templates are DESCRIPTIVE only.
invariants.taskctl_is_source_of_truth: All lifecycle state in taskctl SQLite/JSONL. Autolaunch reads from taskctl, never maintains parallel state.
invariants.neural_routing_only: Neural router (b254) selects adapter/runner/topic. It does NOT authorize launches. Neural = routing; Gates = safety.
invariants.no_regex_keyword_launch_authority: No regex/keyword/table logic may authorize a launch.
invariants.static_allowlist_safety_floor: LAUNCHABLE_BINARIES allowlist is the deterministic safety floor; no binary outside it may be spawned.
invariants.per_model_isolation: Each adapter operates in strict isolation: separate namespaces, claim pools, cost tracking, timeouts.
invariants.audit_log_append_only: Audit log is append-only JSONL; never modified or deleted.

neural_bridge_note: This protocol spec defines the DETERMINISTIC CONTRACT that a learned neural autolaunch controller must satisfy. The neural controller (trained on b254 curriculum rows) selects adapter/runner/topic and decides launch/abstain. This spec defines what 'launch' MEANS: the state machine, gates, audit trail, completion path. The neural controller learns to navigate this protocol; the protocol is the deterministic substrate. Future dryrun tasks measure whether models correctly predict state transitions, gate outcomes, and abstain decisions under this protocol.

context7_usage.reason: Pure repo-local protocol spec over existing taskctl + completion_inbox infrastructure. No external library/API/SDK question open.
